report.summary: Four findings: missing hash functions in bus.py (critical), unverified docstring claims in render.py (critical), token count mismatch between slice.py and harness.py (high), budget errors not tracked in canary.py (medium). Plan: verify and fix each.
risks: Missing hash functions in bus.py would cause runtime failures; cannot fix without full file.
Docstring claims may be misleading; requires full render.py to verify.
Token count mismatch is intentional but may cause confusion; need to document or align.
Budget errors not tracked in canary exit code; may hide unavailability.
todos: 1. Find and verify _body_sha and _entry_sha in full bus.py; if missing, define them.
2. Read full render.py and verify docstring claims; update docstring or code as needed.
3. Compare token counting implementations in slice.py and harness.py; document differences or unify.
4. Add budget error handling to canary.py exit code.

items.title: Verify and fix missing hash functions in bus.py
items.why_now: Runtime failure if verify_chain is called without these functions; critical for kernel reliability.

steps.do: Search for 'def _body_sha' and 'def _entry_sha' in full daedalus/council/bus.py. If not found, check imports. If missing, define them using hashlib.sha256.
steps.verified_by: Run test that calls verify_chain and assert no NameError.

items.assumption: The functions are not defined elsewhere in bus.py or imported; full file not available in context.

items.title: Verify and align render.py docstring with implementation
items.why_now: Misleading docstring causes confusion and potential misuse; critical for documentation accuracy.

steps.do: Read full daedalus/mapping/render.py and verify each docstring claim (analyse_once, gate mode, reconciliation, stamp generation, snapshot handling, escaping). Update docstring or implement missing behavior.
steps.verified_by: Run render module tests and assert docstring matches behavior.

items.assumption: Full render.py is accessible; claims may be partially implemented.

items.title: Document or unify token counting methods in slice.py and harness.py
items.why_now: Inconsistent reduction_pct values cause confusion; high severity because it affects evaluation metrics.

steps.do: Compare count_tokens in daedalus/structcore/slice.py and _whole_repo_text in daedalus/eval/harness.py. Add docstring explaining difference or refactor to use same method.
steps.verified_by: Run both token counting functions on same input and output differing counts; document in code.

steps.do: Update harness.py to use same token counting method or add comment referencing slice.py.
steps.verified_by: Run evaluation tests and assert consistent behavior.

items.assumption: The difference is intentional; decision to unify may require design discussion.

items.title: Add budget error tracking to canary exit code
items.why_now: Budget errors silently pass liveness checks; medium severity but easy to fix.

steps.do: Search for 'budget' or 'BudgetError' in daedalus/council/canary.py. If not handled, add catch for BudgetError and set non-zero exit code.
steps.verified_by: Run canary test with simulated budget error and assert non-zero exit.

items.assumption: BudgetError is defined elsewhere; canary.py currently ignores it.
